story.iWant: to track students who were assigned but never attended (no-show) or left before completion (early termination)
story.soThat: I can report on no-shows, follow up appropriately, and track owed days for potential future placements

subtasks.subtask: 5.1 Add No-Show button to placement card/edit form
5.2 Add Early Termination button to placement card/edit form
5.3 Update StatusTransitionActions.tsx to include no-show/termination options

acceptanceCriteria.ac: "Mark No-Show" action on pending/active placements - Button visible and functional on placement card
No-show sets status to complete with no_show flag - status='complete', no_show=true, days_remaining preserved
"Early Termination" action on active placements - Button visible and functional on active placements
Early termination captures reason - Reason required (min 10 chars) and saved to completion_notes
Days remaining tracked for future reference - days_remaining preserved in placement record
Both actions logged to audit trail - Audit entries created with event details
TrespassTracker synced on completion - syncTrespassTrackerExpiration() called

constraints.constraint: Follow existing server action pattern: validate input with Zod schema, get tenant/user, query supabase, handle errors, log audit, revalidate paths
Use AlertDialog for confirmation-style dialogs (NoShowDialog), Dialog for form-style dialogs (EarlyTerminationDialog)
No-show bypasses state machine - directly sets status='complete' without going through met/transition
All queries must use RLS with tenant_id = get_my_tenant_id()
TrespassTracker sync failure should log warning but NOT block status update
All no-show/termination actions must be logged to admin_audit_log via logAuditEvent()
days_remaining MUST be preserved on no-show/termination to track owed days
Early termination reason must be at least 10 characters
Use toast from sonner for success/error feedback
Follow shadcn/ui component patterns from existing dialogs

tests.standards: Manual testing required - no automated test framework configured. Follow test scenarios in Task 6 of story file. Verify each AC with specific test cases covering happy path and edge cases.
